description: Geluidsbelasting verkeer en industrie dag Den Haag is a dataset listed in den-haag-opendata open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by den-haag-opendata. Beschrijving: Bronjaar 2016. De kaarten bieden een weergave van de berekende geluidsbelasting op de gevels van gebouwen. Op alle geluidsgevoelige gebouwen zijn op de gevels rekenpunten op 4 meter hoogte gegenereerd. Op deze rekenpunten is de geluidsbelasting berekend. Daardoor is het geluidsbeeld op stedelijk niveau vrij betrouwbaar. Coverage: The Hague. The portal files it under Nature and environment. The portal shows 5,718 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-05-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-den-haag-opendata-portal.
